comments.text: My husband works at this plant and they have been having issues long before this massive layoff. They have been shutting down during the months of November through January for the past 2 years, leaving people scrambling to figure out how to make ends meet during those months. This company has been open for just over 5 years and my husband has been there from the beginning. The pay is great but the unexpected shut downs and layoffs are insane. We are just grateful that he wasn't one of the 958 people left unemployed, which was absolutely awful to witness longtime coworkers and friends just gone with just a 24 hour notice. A lot of those people are still unemployed nearly two months later. Georgia is struggling.
